text: Add status_code and status_reason as nullable columns using an online-safe DDL path.
Add both columns NOT NULL with defaults in one migration and allow the table rewrite to finish before deploy.
Deploy compatibility code that keeps old status and new fields semantically consistent on writes.
During compatibility, read new fields when present but fall back to status for rows not yet backfilled.
Backfill historical rows in small resumable batches with progress checkpoints.
Backfill all 80M rows in one UPDATE during the deployment window.
Verify parity between old and new representations on production data after backfill.
Run a rollback drill proving v2-written data remains correct when read by v1.
After the rollback window closes, stop compatibility reads/writes in a later release.
After compatibility is removed, enforce final nullability/consistency constraints for the new representation.
Drop status in the same release that first deploys v2.
Remove status only in a later cleanup release after rollback compatibility is no longer required.
Have application startup ALTER the production table if the new columns are missing.
Create a replacement orders_v2 table and atomically rename tables during the rolling deployment.
